title: feat(011sk16): (0,1,1) same-k reverse fails at k=1 and holds k=2..5
science: Mirror-image contrast with #6775: under (0,1,1) the SAME-k reverse FAILS at k=1 (3 < 9) and holds at k=2,3,4,5, whereas nu holds at every k=1..5. The cause is isolated: (0,1,1)'s cheap seed-exit makes t(1,0,0)=1, so the axis site is too fast at the smallest scale. Also records the axis crossover explicitly -- t(k,0,0) = 1,4,7 matches the axis-skeleton sums for k<=3 but t(4,0,0)=8 < 10 and t(5,0,0)
verdict_pair: same-k reverse: NO at k=1; YES k=2,3,4,5
